batch_order: world-major, all 16 queries every step; no shuffling

gates.tiny_feasibility: 32/32 intact correct; 4/4 unique affected correct intact-to-twin flips; 0/12 unaffected flips; ties are not correct. Evaluate native and FP32 separately.
gates.objective_attainment: all four unique affected FP32 donor-signed changes >= 0.25
gates.selectivity_screen: minimum affected signed change > maximum absolute unaffected twin change; strict diagnostic screen, not a universal bound
gates.pooling_specific_benefit: mean_span passes the same native tiny-feasibility gate while final fails at fixed step256
gates.execution: exact ordinary/split native and written-zero parity; finite computations; frozen base/source unchanged; 256 steps in both cells; resource guards

claim_boundary: Two previously exposed training worlds and one seed; no heldout or correctness non-regression qualification.
Fresh identical initial bridge, same frozen CUDA features, optimizer, objective, readout and budget; only reader query representation differs.
Pooling only inference-visible question tokens; original final normalized prediction state remains the base head input.
No gain tuning, automatic retries, generation, paid judges, full-backbone update, offload or quantization.
Native versus FP32 changes postnorm composition and head arithmetic, not whole-model precision.
Query-only base lacks facts and is an unequal-information reference.
Twin changes serialization as well as ranking; raw-L2 random control does not match all effective reader statistics.
step128 is diagnostic, never best-checkpoint selection. Winner none; semantic promotion false; FT-beta unqualified.
Allocator cap excludes CUDA context and non-Torch allocations; sampled process peak is not a continuous high-water mark.
Abort only this run on insufficient headroom. Do not modify any other job. Keep two small checkpoints per new condition.
